_readme: Yeh hi jagah hai jahan aap notification likhte hain. Neeche 'items' mein ek entry jodiye, phir GitHub par 'Send notification' workflow chalaiye. Site par bell list aur users ke phone/desktop par browser notification — dono isi file se aate hain. 'id' unique rakhiye (dobara wahi id na dein). 'title' aur 'body' dono language mein likhiye.
